117742.name: Beit Jabad Villa Crespo
117742.note: 'BEIT JABAD VILLA CRESPO ... Establecido: Adar 5746 – Marzo 1986. Inauguracion Sede: Adar 5746 – Marzo 1986. Serrano 69 ... Zona de influencia: Villa Crespo y Paternal' (Jabad Argentina's own list of its centers ('Batei Jabad en Argentina y en el mundo': its old site, kept at archivo.jabad.org.ar/batei-jabad, and the July 2010 copy on the Wayback Machine); director in 2010 Rabbi Mordejai Birman). Its annex is the Templo Etz Hajaim, Julián Álvarez 745. Its chabad.org listing went up on 2004-07-22.

118180.name: Beit Jabad Villa Devoto/Villa del Parque
118180.note: 'BEIT JABAD VILLA DEVOTO / VILLA DEL PARQUE. Director: Rabino David Stoler. Establecido: Shvat 5751 – Enero de 1991. Inauguración Sede: M.Av 5753 – Agosto de 1993. Helguera 2329 / 2333' (Jabad Argentina's own list of its centers ('Batei Jabad en Argentina y en el mundo': its old site, kept at archivo.jabad.org.ar/batei-jabad, and the July 2010 copy on the Wayback Machine)). In March 2005 Rabbi David Stoler also ran the Tel Aviv School on Helguera Street, Villa del Parque, and Chabad's Hillel School (lubavitch.com, 11 March 2005). Its chabad.org listing went up on 2004-07-22.

118219.name: Beit Jabad Almagro
118219.note: 'BEIT JABAD ALMAGRO – ABASTO. Director: Rabino Asher Manes Schvetz. Establecido: Elul 5754 – Septiembre de 1994. Funciona en el Templo Barón Hirsch desde: Elul 5754 – Septiembre de 1994. Billingurst 664' (Jabad Argentina's own list of its centers ('Batei Jabad en Argentina y en el mundo': its old site, kept at archivo.jabad.org.ar/batei-jabad, and the July 2010 copy on the Wayback Machine)). Chabad 'paid to save' the Baron Hirsch Synagogue and Talmud Torah, 'opening a vibrant Chabad Center and kindergarten for the Almagro Jewish community' (lubavitch.com, March 2005); its school began in 2001 and a seven-storey building was finished in 2014-15 (Itón Gadol, Sept 2014). (Elul 5754 ended on 5 September 1994, so only the year is entered.) Its chabad.org listing went up on 2004-07-22.

118483.name: Beit Chabad Caballito
118483.note: 'BEIT JABAD CABALLITO. Director: Rabino Gabriel Setton. Establecido: Elul 5756 – Septiembre 1996. Inauguración Sede: Elul 5756 – Septiembre 1996. Paysandú 494' (Jabad Argentina's own list of its centers ('Batei Jabad en Argentina y en el mundo': its old site, kept at archivo.jabad.org.ar/batei-jabad, and the July 2010 copy on the Wayback Machine); later 'Nueva dirección Ambrosetti 543'). (Elul 5756 ended on 13 September 1996, so only the year is entered.) Its chabad.org listing went up on 2004-07-22.

earlier.where: Paysandú 494, Caballito (its address in 2010; now Ambrosetti 543)

118010.name: Beit Jabad Palermo Comunidad
118010.note: 'BEIT JABAD PALERMO. Director: Rabino Shlomó Levy. Establecido: Adar 5755 – Marzo 1995. Inauguración Sede: Adar 5755 – Marzo 1995. Pasaje El Lazo 3133 ... Zona de influencia: Palermo y Barrio Norte. Rabinato, Templo, Centro de estudios judaicos dedicado exclusivamente a jóvenes en edad universitaria' (Jabad Argentina's own list of its centers ('Batei Jabad en Argentina y en el mundo': its old site, kept at archivo.jabad.org.ar/batei-jabad, and the July 2010 copy on the Wayback Machine)): one Beit Jabad then, the community and the youth centre (El Lazo, 'In 1995, Rabbi Shlomo and Rebbetzin Rachel Levy opened ... El Lazo', COLlive, Dec 2025). Jabad Argentina's list today has them apart: 'Beit Jabad Palermo, Las Heras 3515' and 'Centro para la Juventud, Pje. El Lazo 3133'. Its chabad.org listing went up on 2004-07-22.

earlier.where: Pasaje El Lazo 3133 (with the youth centre; now Las Heras 3515)

477149.name: Beit Jabad Villa Urquiza
477149.note: 'BEIT JABAD VILLA URQUIZA. Director: Rabino Matitiau Winer. Establecido: Jeshvan 5761, noviembre 2000. Avalos 2174 ... Zona de influencia: Villa Urquiza, Villa Pueyrredon, Parque Chaz' (Jabad Argentina's own list of its centers ('Batei Jabad en Argentina y en el mundo': its old site, kept at archivo.jabad.org.ar/batei-jabad, and the July 2010 copy on the Wayback Machine); now Ginebra 4033). Its chabad.org listing went up on 2007-02-14.

118440.name: Beis Chabad Recoleta
118440.note: 'BEIT JABAD RECOLETA. Director: Rabino Hirshel Hendel. Establecido: 2-3-2001. Ayacucho 1416' (Jabad Argentina's own list of its centers ('Batei Jabad en Argentina y en el mundo': its old site, kept at archivo.jabad.org.ar/batei-jabad, and the July 2010 copy on the Wayback Machine)). 2-3-2001 is 2 March 2001 (7 Adar 5761) the Argentine way, or 3 February (Yud Shevat 5761): either is 5761, so no day entered. Its chabad.org listing went up on 2004-07-22.

119911.name: Beit Jabad Zona Norte
119911.note: 'BEIT JABAD ZONA NORTE. Director: Rabino Abraham Benchimol. Establecido: Sivan 5757 – Junio 1997. Inauguración Sede: Sivan 5757 – Junio 1997. Tres Sargentos 2067 (B1640BLO) Martínez ... Zona de influencia: Partidos de Vicente López, San Isidro, San Fernando y Tigre' (Jabad Argentina's list of its centers, July 2010 copy on the Wayback Machine; its later version drops the date). Its chabad.org listing went up on 2004-07-22.

437377.name: Jabad Lubavitch Salta
437377.note: 'BEIT JABAD SALTA. Director: Rabino Rafael Tawil. Establecido: Elul 5764 – Septiembre de 2004. Caseros 1023' (Jabad Argentina's own list of its centers ('Batei Jabad en Argentina y en el mundo': its old site, kept at archivo.jabad.org.ar/batei-jabad, and the July 2010 copy on the Wayback Machine)). The Sociedad Israelita La Unión of Salta was founded in 1914, and 'Noventa años después, Jabad Lubavitch abrió sus puertas en dicha Kehilá' (AMIA's Vaad Hakehilot directory). Its chabad.org listing went up on 2006-10-19.

118565.name: Beit Jabad Zona Oeste
118565.note: 'El Centro Comunitario Beit Jabad Zona Oeste, comenzó sus actividades en el año 2001, fundado y dirigido desde entonces y hasta la fecha por el Rab. [Iosi Ludman]' (Radio Jai, 'Conociendo al Rabino Iosi Ludman', 25 Aug 2020). Its school, Ilan School by Wolfsohn, began on 15 March 2011 after Ramat Shalom closed (Itón Gadol, Aug 2011). Casullo 180, Morón. Its chabad.org listing went up on 2004-07-22.

5269147.name: Beit Jabad Levi Yitzjak
5269147.note: 'Fundada en 2008 como un centro de estudios judaicos, en homenaje al Rabí Leví Itzjak Schneerson, padre del Rebe de Lubavitch, en el 2018 se transforma en una comunidad al establecer su Beit Hakneset en la calle Echeverría 2773, en el barrio de Belgrano' (Itón Gadol, 24 Aug 2021, at the writing of its new Sefer Torah). Its chabad.org listing went up on 2021-10-10.

119276.name: Beit Jabad Or Sinai
119276.note: 'También en Palermo funciona desde noviembre pasado un centro de estudios de Torá y Cábala con cursos dirigidos por el rabino Pinjas Sudry ... Si bien el proyecto del Instituto de Torá y Cábala Or Sinai es nuevo, se viene gestando desde hace algunos años' (Itón Gadol, 9 Dec 2007); 'Nosotros empezamos hace 8 años en una mesa con cuatro alumnos' (Rabbi Sudry, Itón Gadol, April 2016, as it moved to a new building in Barrio Norte). Medium: its chabad.org listing number is from the directory's first upload (2004-07-22), so the listing may once have been another center's. Now Vidt 1982.

117745.name: Chabad Lubavitch Argentina HQ
117745.note: 'Antes de afincarse en Buenos Aires, al ser designado Shliaj (enviado) del Rebe, el rabino Dovber Baumgarten z'l efectuó una gira por diversos países latinoamericanos en el año 1955, y se estableció en Buenos Aires en 1957' (Itón Gadol, 7 March 2018, at a tribute to him). Chabadpedia's Argentina page: he worked there for the summer months before, and 'רק בשנת תשי"ח קבע בה את מגוריו והביא אליה את משפחתו' (only in 5718 did he settle there and bring his family; his own page has him settling in Cheshvan 5723). Chabad.org counts his work 'from 1955' (CrownHeights.info's copy, Dec 2023). Rabbi Tzvi Grunblatt came in 1978 to take his place (the head shliach since). Agüero 1164. Its chabad.org listing went up on 2004-07-22.

439472.name: Chabad-Lubavitch Puerto Madero
439472.note: Rabbi Chaim Oirechman to the Agencia Judía de Noticias: 'Empezamos en 2005: Puerto Madero era el barrio más nuevo, no había un templo' (Itón Gadol, 23 Jan 2014); its historic house was lent by a decree of 6 Dec 2007 and 'el Beit Jabad de Puerto Madero se inauguró oficialmente el 15 de septiembre de 2009'. His appointment had been announced in October 2004: 'Grunblatt announced the appointment of Rabbi and Mrs. Chayim Baruch Oirechman to Puerto Madera ... beginning with a pre-school and a shul' (lubavitch.com, 25 Oct 2004). Chabadpedia (his page): 'בשנת תשס"ה יצא ביחד עם זוגתו מרת ברכה מרים ובנם מנחם מענדל לשליחות בפוארטו מאדרו' (5765). Its chabad.org listing went up on 2006-10-27.

117741.name: Beit Jabad Bahia Blanca
117741.note: 'Chabad of Bahia Blanca was founded in 1985 by Rabbi Moshe and Sarah Freedman' (lubavitch.com, March 2025); 'Jabad se estableció en el 1985 con la llegada del Rabino Moshe Freedman z"l y su familia, a pedido de la Kehilá local para un Rabino ... En el 1994 se inauguró el centro del BeitJabad que sirve hasta hoy en día' (AMIA's Vaad Hakehilot directory, text from the kehilá); 'Freedman arrived there in 1985' (COLlive, Aug 2016). (CrownHeights.info, March 2018, says 'Since 1986'; COLlive, Jan 2021: the first public menorah, Chanukah 1986, came a year and three months after he arrived.) Chabadpedia (his page, no footnote): he joined the shluchim in Argentina in תשמ"ה (5745) and was sent as rabbi of Bahía Blanca's Jewish community; no Hebrew year entered, since the arrival may have been just after Rosh Hashanah 5746. Rabbi Moshe Freedman passed away on 22 Tammuz 5776 (July 2016); his son Rabbi Shmuel and Shterni Freedman came at Chanukah 2020. Jabad Argentina's own list of its centers gives a later date for the Beit Jabad itself: 'Establecido: Elul 5746 – Septiembre 1986. Inauguración Sede: Adar 5752 – Marzo 1992. Chiclana 763' (July 2010 copy on the Wayback Machine): he came in 1985 as the community's rabbi, and the Beit Jabad was set up a year later, so medium. Its chabad.org listing went up on 2004-07-22.

117924.name: Beit Jabad Flores
117924.note: 'היאחזות חב"ד בשכונה החלה בממדים צנועים בשנת תשנ"ב, כאשר הרב דוד פלאטקא החל לשמש בה שליח. בית-חב"ד שהקים שכן בדירה קטנה ושכורה, אך בשנת תשנ"ד התרחבה הקהילה ורכשה את בית-חב"ד הנוכחי' (Chabad in the neighbourhood began modestly in 5752, when Rabbi Dovid Plotka started as its shliach, in a small rented apartment; in 5754 the community bought its house) (COL, 4 Jan 2004, at the inauguration of its new building, a copy of 770). Chabadpedia (his page) agrees: in 5752, with the Rebbe's blessing, a Chabad house opened in Flores. His sons run Flores Norte (Andrés Lamas), Floresta and Or Sinai. Jabad Argentina's list of its centers: 'Establecido: Elul 5752 – Septiembre de 1992. Inauguración Sede: Elul 5754 -Septiembre de 1994. Helguera 634'. Its chabad.org listing went up on 2004-07-22.

earlier.where: a small rented apartment in Flores (5752-5754)

117748.name: Beit Jabad Tucuman
117748.note: 'Jabad Tucumán fue fundada un 4 de julio de 1982 – 12 de Tamuz del calendario hebreo, con la llegada del Rabino Israel Daniel Levy y su Esposa Miriam' (AMIA's Vaad Hakehilot directory of the interior's communities, 'Año de inauguración: 1982'; the text was supplied by the kehilá). (12 Tammuz 5742 fell on 3 July; the date is as the source has it.) Also 'El rabino Danel Levy es el director de Beit Jabad Tucuman, desde 1982' (es.chabad.org). Chabadpedia (his page): at the end of 5741, in kollel in Buenos Aires, he was offered Tucumán among other places, and the couple went after their wedding. Lamadrid 752 (Gan, Talmud Torah), Lamadrid 623 (mikvah, Centro Médico Maimónides), Lamadrid 770 (temple). Its chabad.org listing went up on 2004-07-22. Jabad Argentina's list of its centers: 'Establecido: Tamúz 5742 – Julio 1982. Inauguración Sede propia: Edificio Beit Ovadiá, Noviembre de 1983'.

117747.name: Beit Jabad Rosario
117747.note: 'Llegamos a Rosario como emisarios del Rebe de Lubavich para fundar Beit Jabad Rosario. Mi señora Jaia Sarah Dahan yo, Shlomo Tawil, junto a mi hija Jana de 3 meses en Febrero de 1987 ... En 1988 se colocó la piedra fundamental para nuestra sede. En 1992 se inauguró la mikve y en 1994 se inauguró el resto del edificio' (AMIA's Vaad Hakehilot directory, text from the kehilá; Mendoza 1572). Also 'When Tawil arrived with his wife Chaya Sara in 1987 to establish a Chabad presence' (lubavitch.com, Sept 2005) and 'he has served as the Chabad emissary in Rosario since 1987' (COLlive and CrownHeights.info, June 2019). A branch in Puerto Norte is run by Rabbi Mendi Tawil. Its chabad.org listing went up on 2004-07-22. Jabad Argentina's list of its centers: 'Establecido: Shvat 5747 – Febrero 1987. Inauguración Sede: Elul 5754 – Septiembre 1994'.

117746.name: Beit Jabad Cordoba
117746.note: 'Inaugurado el 30 de Diciembre de 1989, el BeitJabad comenzó con un pequeño templo en la calle Faustino Allende de Barrio Cofico. En 1992, el BeitJabad mudó sus instalaciones, a un espacio mucho más grande ubicado en la calle Sucre 1378' (AMIA's Vaad Hakehilot directory, text from the kehilá). Rabbi Yossi Turk, in his own words: 'In 1989, Rabbi Zvi Grunblatt, the head shliach of Argentina, came into kollel looking for a shliach for Cordoba ... My wife, our baby, and I arrived in Cordoba in December 1989, Kislev 5750' (COLlive, 22 July 2022); 'Rabbi Yossi and Chana Turk, co-directors of Jabad Lubavitch Cordoba since 1989' (CrownHeights.info, March 2014). Its mikvah came five years after they arrived; Gan Meorot preschool in 2004. Its chabad.org listing went up on 2004-07-22. Jabad Argentina's list of its centers: 'Establecido: Kislev 5752 [sic, for 5750] – Diciembre de 1989. Inauguración Sede: Adar 5752 -Febrero de 1992. Sucre 1378/80'.

earlier.where: a small temple on calle Faustino Allende, Barrio Cofico

3418334.name: Beit Jabad Concordia
3418334.note: 'Rabbi Yisroel Soriano and his wife Chana arrived in Concordia, Argentina five years ago and immediately went to work' (COLlive, 20 March 2021): so about 2016 (counted back, medium). Its listing number (3418334, just after one made on 2016-08-17) says its chabad.org listing was first made about August 2016 (chabad.org's record shows 2018-01-29, a later republication). An earlier shlichus there had ended: 'In 1982 Rabbi Yisroel and Miriam Kapeluschnik went out on shlichus to Concordia' (COLlive, Jan 2024); Chabadpedia: from Kislev 5743, for 18 years, then Buenos Aires in 5760. Jabad Argentina's 2010 list still had the old house: 'BEIT JABAD CONCORDIA. Establecido: Kilev 5747 [sic] – Diciembre 1982 ... Temporalmente contactar a Rab. Israel Kapelushnik'.

7447577.name: Beit Jabad Santa Fe
7447577.note: 'Rabbi Shamai and Devo Chein, together with their daughter Chana, are preparing to move on shlichus to Santa Fe, Argentina ... The new shluchim will work to establish a warm address for every Yid in the city and surrounding areas' (COLlive, 22 Oct 2026). Its chabad.org listing went up on 2026-08-19, before the move (6 Elul 5786; the move is in 5787, so no Hebrew year). An earlier shlichus there had ended: Jabad Argentina's 2010 list had 'BEIT JABAD SANTA FE, Rabino Iair Vasershten, San Jeronimo 3184'.

477074.name: Chabad Lubavich Bariloche
477074.note: 'In addition to the one in Salvador, new Chabad centers have opened in Cusco, Peru; Buenos Aires and Bariloche, Argentina' (lubavitch.com, 5 Nov 2006): permanent centers for Israeli backpackers, funded by South American philanthropists after 'a Seder for hundreds of Israeli backpackers in Bariloche'. Its chabad.org listing went up on 2007-02-14. 'Along with his wife Shifra and seven children, Rabbi Klein has been the Chabad representative in Bariloche since 2009' (lubavitch.com, 13 May 2026). In July 2010 Jabad Argentina's list had 'BEIT JABAD BARILOCHE, Emilio Frey 166 ... Rab. Nir Azai. Cerrado hasta Septiembre' (seasonal).
